title: Edit an environment variable from the tooltip on the request URL
steps: Hover the <<site>> placeholder to display its environment values and edit icon.
Move the pointer from the placeholder toward the popup's edit icon.

video_guide.summary: The variable popup remains reachable across the pointer move, allowing its edit icon to open the Website Variables editor.

chapters.note: The site placeholder's tooltip shows its values and edit icon.
The variable tooltip and its edit icon are still visible.
Edit Environment is open for Website Variables with the site row visible.
